mapper.select: SELECT pl.id AS location_id, pl.name, pl.description, pl.visual_prompt FROM scenes s JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = s.chapter_id LEFT JOIN project_locations pl ON pl.id = s.project_location_id WHERE s.id = #{sceneId} AND ch.project_id = #{projectId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pc.id AS assignment_id, c.id AS character_id, c.canonical_name, canon.version_number, canon.visual_prompt, appearance.appearance_prompt, appearance.age_state, appearance.hairstyle, appearance.injury, appearance.wardrobe_context, canon.master_asset_id, master_asset.storage_key AS master_asset_storage_key, master_asset.mime_type AS master_asset_mime_type FROM scene_characters sc JOIN scenes s ON s.id = sc.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = s.chapter_id JOIN project_characters pc ON pc.id = sc.project_character_id JOIN characters c ON c.id = pc.character_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cv.version_number, cv.visual_prompt, cv.master_asset_id FROM character_versions cv WHERE cv.character_id = c.id AND ( cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id OR ( pc.pinned_character_version_id IS NULL AND cv.status = 'LOCKED' ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cv.version_number DESC, cv.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) canon ON TRUE LEFT JOIN project_assets master_asset ON master_asset.id = canon.master_asset_id AND master_asset.project_id = pc.project_id AND master_asset.asset_type = 'IMAGE' AND master_asset.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ca.appearance_prompt, ca.age_state, ca.hairstyle, ca.injury, ca.wardrobe_context FROM character_appearances ca WHERE ca.character_id = c.id AND (ca.project_id = pc.project_id OR ca.project_id IS NULL) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ca.project_id = pc.project_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ca.updated_at DESC, ca.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) appearance ON TRUE WHERE sc.scene_id = #{sceneId} AND ch.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sc.order_index, pc.id
